description: This file defines the custom exception class 'ThingNotAccessibleException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a specific 'Thing' was either not found or the requester lacked permissions. The class includes constructors, message formatting, and a builder pattern for creating instances.

classes.name: ThingNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class representing a scenario where a 'Thing' is either missing or access is forbidden in the Ditto system.

classes.name: ThingNotAccessibleException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of 'ThingNotAccessibleException' with fluent API.

methods.name: ThingNotAccessibleException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with headers, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates an exception message based on the 'ThingId'.

methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for this exception type.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.
